correctness.rationale: On both signs of the 2-adic unit group, the submitted signed logarithmic interpolation is an isometry. For x=1 mod 4 the initial displacement valuation is 2r, and for x=-1 mod 4 it is r+1 for one iterate and 3r for the squared map. The sharp 2-adic displacement doubling lemma yields least periods 2^max(0,k-2r) and 1 if k<=r+1, else 2^max(1,k-3r+1); counting exactly 2^(k-r-1) points per valuation layer establishes all cycle counts and exactly two longest cycles for k>=6. Independent direct enumeration of every odd state through k=12 agreed; the proof, not that finite check, supplies arbitrary k.
